description: Maps CheckID checks to SCF controls. Source of truth for Build-Registry.ps1.

checks.name: Ensure Administrative accounts are cloud-only
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict the assignment of privileged accounts to management-approved personnel and/or roles exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Create cloud-only admin accounts instead of using on-premises synced accounts. Entra admin center > Users > New user > Create user (cloud identity).

checks.name: On-premises synced admin accounts (compromise path)
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict the assignment of privileged accounts to management-approved personnel and/or roles exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

checks.name: Ensure two emergency access accounts have been defined
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to disable or remove temporary and emergency accounts after an organization-defined time period for each type of account exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.
checks.remediation: Maintain at least two cloud-only emergency access accounts excluded from all Conditional Access policies.

checks.name: Ensure that between two and four global admins are designated
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict the assignment of privileged accounts to management-approved personnel and/or roles exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: The Global Administrator directory role is not activated in this tenant. Activate the role by assigning at least one user, then re-run the assessment.

checks.name: No break-glass emergency access account detected
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to disable or remove temporary and emergency accounts after an organization-defined time period for each type of account exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

checks.name: Ensure administrative accounts use licenses with a reduced application footprint
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict the assignment of privileged accounts to management-approved personnel and/or roles exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Assign admin accounts minimal licenses (Entra ID P2). Do not assign E3/E5 productivity suites. M365 admin center > Users > Active users > Licenses.

checks.name: Ensure that only organizationally managed/approved public groups exist
checks.impactRationale: Failure to define, document, approve and enforce access restrictions associated with changes to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.
checks.remediation: Assign owners to ownerless public M365 groups. Entra admin center > Groups > All groups > select group > Owners > Add owners.

checks.name: Ensure sign-in to shared mailboxes is blocked
checks.impactRationale: Failure to proactively govern account management of individual, group, system, service, application, guest and temporary accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Block sign-in for shared mailbox accounts: Set-AzureADUser -ObjectId <UPN> -AccountEnabled $false. Entra admin center > Users > select shared mailbox user > Properties > Account enabled > No.

checks.name: Ensure the 'Password expiration policy' is set to 'Set passwords to never expire'
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enforce complexity, length and lifespan considerations to ensure strong criteria for password-based authentication exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: Update-MgDomain -DomainId {domain} -PasswordValidityPeriodInDays 2147483647. M365 admin center > Settings > Password expiration policy.

checks.name: Ensure 'Idle session timeout' is set to '3 hours (or less)' for unmanaged devices
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to log out users, both locally on the network and for remote sessions, at the end of the session or after an organization-defined period of inactivity exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment.
checks.remediation: Run: Set-SPOBrowserIdleSignOut -Enabled $true -SignOutAfter ''01:00:00''. M365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Idle session timeout.

checks.name: Ensure 'External sharing' of calendars is not available
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to prevent the unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive/regulated data across managed interfaces exposes the tenant to: Emergent properties and/or unintended consequences, Data loss / corruption, Information loss / corruption or system.
checks.remediation: Exchange admin center > Organization > Sharing > Default sharing policy. Remove wildcard (*) domains or restrict to CalendarSharingFreeBusySimple.

checks.name: Ensure 'User owned apps and services' is restricted
checks.impactRationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions > User consent settings > Do not allow user consent.

checks.name: Ensure internal phishing protection for Forms is enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize anti-phishing and spam protection technologies to detect and take action on unsolicited messages transported by electronic mail exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.
checks.remediation: M365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > ensure internal phishing protection is enabled.

checks.name: Ensure the customer lockbox feature is enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment.
checks.remediation: M365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Security & privacy > Customer Lockbox > Require approval. Requires E5 or equivalent.

checks.name: Ensure 'third-party storage services' are restricted in 'Microsoft 365 on the web'
checks.impactRationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.
checks.remediation: M365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft 365 on the web > uncheck all third-party storage services.

checks.name: Ensure that Sways cannot be shared with people outside of your organization
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to prevent the unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive/regulated data across managed interfaces exposes the tenant to: Emergent properties and/or unintended consequences, Data loss / corruption, Information loss / corruption or system.

checks.name: Ensure shared bookings pages are restricted to select users
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment.
checks.remediation: M365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Bookings > restrict shared booking pages to selected staff members.

checks.name: Ensure Safe Links for Office Applications is Enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: New-SafeLinksPolicy -Name "Safe Links" -IsEnabled $true; New-SafeLinksRule -Name "Safe Links" -SafeLinksPolicy "Safe Links" -RecipientDomainIs (Get-AcceptedDomain).Name. Security admin center > Safe Links > Create a policy covering all users.

checks.name: Ensure the Common Attachment Types Filter is enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: Set-MalwareFilterPolicy -Identity <PolicyName> -EnableFileFilter $true. Security admin center > Anti-malware > Default policy > Common attachments filter > Enable.

checks.name: Ensure notifications for internal users sending malware is Enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to generate, monitor, correlate and respond to alerts from physical, cybersecurity, data protection and supply chain activities to achieve integrated situational awareness exposes the tenant to: Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s), Loss of integrity.
checks.remediation: Run: Set-MalwareFilterPolicy -Identity <PolicyName> -EnableInternalSenderAdminNotifications $true -InternalSenderAdminAddress admin@domain.com. Security admin center > Anti-malware > Default policy > Admin notifications > Notify admin about undelivered messages from internal senders.

checks.name: Ensure Safe Attachments policy is enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: New-SafeAttachmentPolicy -Name "Safe Attachments" -Enable $true -Action Block; New-SafeAttachmentRule -Name "Safe Attachments" -SafeAttachmentPolicy "Safe Attachments" -RecipientDomainIs (Get-AcceptedDomain).Name. Security admin center > Safe Attachments > Create a policy covering all users.

checks.name: Ensure Safe Attachments for SharePoint OneDrive and Microsoft Teams is Enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: Set-AtpPolicyForO365 -EnableATPForSPOTeamsODB $true. Security admin center > Safe Attachments > Global settings > Turn on Defender for Office 365 for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.

checks.name: Ensure Exchange Online Spam Policies are set to notify administrators

checks.name: Ensure comprehensive attachment filtering is applied
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

checks.name: Ensure the connection filter IP allow list is not used

checks.remediation: Run: Set-HostedConnectionFilterPolicy -Identity <Policy> -IPAllowList @{}. Exchange admin center > Protection > Connection filter > Edit the policy and remove all IP allow list entries.

checks.name: Ensure the connection filter safe list is off
checks.impactRationale: Failure to implement and govern Access Control Lists (ACLs) to provide data flow enforcement that explicitly restrict network traffic to only what is authorized exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.
checks.remediation: Run: Set-HostedConnectionFilterPolicy -Identity <Policy> -EnableSafeList $false. Exchange admin center > Protection > Connection filter > Edit the policy and uncheck "Turn on safe list".

checks.name: Ensure inbound anti-spam policies do not contain allowed domains
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize anti-phishing and spam protection technologies to detect and take action on unsolicited messages transported by electronic mail exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.

checks.name: Ensure outbound anti-spam message limits are in place
checks.impactRationale: Failure to document, assess risk and approve or deny deviations to standardized configurations exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy -Identity <PolicyName> -AutoForwardingMode Off. Security admin center > Anti-spam > Outbound policy > Auto-forwarding rules > Off.

checks.name: Ensure Priority account protection is enabled and configured
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Configure preset security policies in Security admin center > Preset security policies > Strict or Standard protection > Assign users/groups.

checks.name: Ensure Priority accounts have 'Strict protection' presets applied
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Assign priority account users to the Strict preset policy. Security admin center > Preset security policies > Strict protection > Manage protection settings > Add users or groups.

checks.name: Ensure Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is enabled and configured
checks.impactRationale: Failure to generate, monitor, correlate and respond to alerts from physical, cybersecurity, data protection and supply chain activities to achieve integrated situational awareness exposes the tenant to: Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s), Loss of integrity.

checks.name: Ensure Zero-hour auto purge for Microsoft Teams is on
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Enable ZAP for Teams in Security admin center > Settings > Zero-hour auto purge > Teams.

checks.name: Ensure Microsoft 365 audit log search is Enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to provide an event log report generation capability to aid in detecting and assessing anomalous activities exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: Set-AdminAuditLogConfig -UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled $true. Microsoft Purview > Audit > Start recording user and admin activity.

checks.name: Ensure DLP policies are enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to prevent the unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive/regulated data across managed interfaces exposes the tenant to: Emergent properties and/or unintended consequences, Data loss / corruption, Information loss / corruption or system.
checks.remediation: Microsoft Purview > Data loss prevention > Policies > Create a DLP policy covering sensitive information types relevant to your organization.

checks.name: Ensure DLP policies are enabled for Microsoft Teams
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to prevent the unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive/regulated data across managed interfaces exposes the tenant to: Emergent properties and/or unintended consequences, Data loss / corruption, Information loss / corruption or system.
checks.remediation: Microsoft Purview > Data loss prevention > Policies > Edit an existing policy or create new > Include Teams chat and channel messages location.

checks.name: Ensure Information Protection sensitivity label policies are published
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to prevent the unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive/regulated data across managed interfaces exposes the tenant to: Emergent properties and/or unintended consequences, Data loss / corruption, Information loss / corruption or system.
checks.remediation: Microsoft Purview > Information protection > Labels > Create and publish sensitivity labels. Then create a label policy to deploy them to users.

checks.name: Ensure external users cannot collaborate on Microsoft Forms
checks.impactRationale: Failure to control publicly-accessible content exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s).
checks.remediation: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Uncheck "People outside your organization can share and collaborate on forms".

checks.name: Ensure external users cannot respond to Microsoft Forms
checks.impactRationale: Failure to control publicly-accessible content exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s).
checks.remediation: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Uncheck "People outside your organization can respond".

checks.name: Ensure Microsoft Forms phishing protection is enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Enable "Internal phishing protection".

checks.impactRationale: Failure to establish and maintain an authoritative source and repository to provide a trusted source and accountability for approved and implemented system components that prevents assets from being duplicated in other asset inventories exposes the tenant to: Emergent properties.

checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize anti-phishing and spam protection technologies to detect and take action on unsolicited messages transported by electronic mail exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.

checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

checks.impactRationale: Failure to document, assess risk and approve or deny deviations to standardized configurations exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment.

checks.impactRationale: Failure to define, document, approve and enforce access restrictions associated with changes to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Users > User settings > Users can register applications > No. Also review Enterprise applications > User settings > Users can consent to apps.

checks.name: Ensure 'Restrict non-admin users from creating tenants' is set to 'Yes'
checks.impactRationale: Failure to define, document, approve and enforce access restrictions associated with changes to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.
checks.remediation: Run: Update-MgPolicyAuthorizationPolicy -DefaultUserRolePermissions @{AllowedToCreateTenants = $false}. Entra admin center > Users > User settings.

checks.name: Ensure access to the Entra admin center is restricted
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict the assignment of privileged accounts to management-approved personnel and/or roles exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Identity > Users > User settings > Administration center > set "Restrict access to Microsoft Entra admin center" to Yes.

checks.name: Ensure the option to remain signed in is hidden

checks.name: Ensure a dynamic group for guest users is created
checks.impactRationale: Failure to proactively govern account management of individual, group, system, service, application, guest and temporary accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Groups > New group > Membership type = Dynamic User > Rule: (user.userType -eq "Guest"). This enables targeted policies for guest users.

checks.name: Ensure users cannot create security groups
checks.impactRationale: Failure to define, document, approve and enforce access restrictions associated with changes to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.
checks.remediation: Run: Update-MgPolicyAuthorizationPolicy -DefaultUserRolePermissions @{AllowedToCreateSecurityGroups = $false}. Entra admin center > Groups > General.

checks.name: Ensure the ability to join devices to Entra is restricted
checks.impactRationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Devices > Device settings > Users may join devices to Microsoft Entra > Selected. Restrict to a specific group of authorized users.

checks.name: Ensure the maximum number of devices per user is limited
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enforce access control requirements for the connection of mobile devices to organizational Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Unauthorized access, Emergent properties and/or.

checks.name: Ensure the GA role is not added as a local administrator during Entra join

checks.name: Ensure local administrator assignment is limited during Entra join
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict the assignment of privileged accounts to management-approved personnel and/or roles exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Devices > Device settings > Manage Additional local administrators on all Azure AD joined devices. Minimize additional local admins.

checks.name: Ensure Local Administrator Password Solution is enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to document, assess risk and approve or deny deviations to standardized configurations exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Devices > Device settings > Enable Microsoft Entra Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) > Yes.

checks.name: Ensure users are restricted from recovering BitLocker keys
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Devices > Device settings > Restrict users from recovering the BitLocker key(s) for their owned devices > Yes.

checks.name: Ensure user consent to apps accessing company data on their behalf is not allowed
checks.impactRationale: Failure to define, document, approve and enforce access restrictions associated with changes to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.
checks.remediation: Run: Update-MgPolicyAuthorizationPolicy -DefaultUserRolePermissions @{PermissionGrantPoliciesAssigned = @()}. Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions.

checks.name: Ensure the admin consent workflow is enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to analyze proposed changes for potential security impacts, prior to the implementation of the change exposes the tenant to: Unauthorized access, Loss of integrity through unauthorized changes, Emergent properties and/or unintended consequences.
checks.remediation: Run: Update-MgPolicyAdminConsentRequestPolicy -IsEnabled $true. Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Admin consent requests.

checks.name: Ensure that collaboration invitations are sent to allowed domains only
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege?" exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > External Identities > External collaboration settings > Collaboration restrictions > Allow invitations only to the specified domains.

checks.name: Ensure that guest user access is restricted
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment.
checks.remediation: Run: Update-MgPolicyAuthorizationPolicy -GuestUserRoleId ''2af84b1e-32c8-42b7-82bc-daa82404023b''. Entra admin center > External Identities > External collaboration settings.

checks.name: Ensure guest user invitations are limited to the Guest Inviter role
checks.impactRationale: Failure to prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions to include disabling, circumventing or altering implemented security safeguards / countermeasures exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged.
checks.remediation: Run: Update-MgPolicyAuthorizationPolicy -AllowInvitesFrom ''adminsAndGuestInviters''. Entra admin center > External Identities > External collaboration settings.

checks.name: Ensure that password hash sync is enabled for hybrid deployments
checks.impactRationale: Failure to ensure default authenticators are changed as part of account creation or system installation exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Verify Password Hash Sync status in Azure AD Connect. Entra admin center > Identity > Hybrid management > Azure AD Connect.

checks.name: Transport Rule Configuration for External Forwarding
checks.impactRationale: Failure to implement and govern Access Control Lists (ACLs) to provide data flow enforcement that explicitly restrict network traffic to only what is authorized exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

checks.name: Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users in administrative roles
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate local access for privileged accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Security Defaults enforces MFA for all admin roles. For granular control, disable Security Defaults and create Conditional Access policies.

checks.name: Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate local access for privileged accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Security Defaults enforces MFA for all users. For granular control, disable Security Defaults and create Conditional Access policies.

checks.name: Enable Conditional Access policies to block legacy authentication

checks.name: Enable Conditional Access policies to block legacy authentication
checks.impactRationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.
checks.remediation: Security Defaults blocks legacy authentication protocols. For granular control, disable Security Defaults and create Conditional Access policies.

checks.remediation: Create a CA policy: Target admin roles > Session > Sign-in frequency (e.g., 4 hours) + Persistent browser session = Never. Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access.

checks.name: Ensure 'Phishing-resistant MFA strength' is required for Administrators
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to employ replay-resistant authentication exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Create a CA policy: Target admin roles > Grant > Require authentication strength > Phishing-resistant MFA. Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access.

checks.remediation: Create a CA policy: Target All users > Conditions > User risk > High > Grant > Require password change + MFA. Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access.

checks.name: Enable Identity Protection sign-in risk policies
checks.impactRationale: Failure to expedite the process of removing "high risk" individual’s access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) upon termination, as determined by management exposes the tenant to: Improper assignment of privileged functions, Unauthorized access.

checks.name: Tier 0 apps with no sign-in activity (unused privileged permissions)
checks.impactRationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to disable inactive accounts after an organization-defined time period exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Review apps with Tier 0 permissions that show no sign-in activity. These permissions may have been granted but never used -- remove them to reduce attack surface. Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Sign-in logs.

checks.name: Foreign apps impersonating Microsoft product display names
checks.impactRationale: Failure to implement an insider threat program that includes a cross-discipline insider threat incident handling team exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Investigate foreign apps using Microsoft product names -- they may be social engineering attempts. Verify the publisher and appId against known Microsoft first-party apps. Remove if suspicious.

checks.name: Multi-tenant app registrations (AzureADMultipleOrgs)
checks.impactRationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.
checks.remediation: Review multi-tenant apps and restrict to AzureADMyOrg if they do not need cross-tenant access. Multi-tenant apps can be accessed by users from any Entra ID tenant. Entra admin center > App registrations > Authentication > Supported account types.

checks.name: Security Defaults Gap Analysis (CA Coverage)
checks.impactRationale: Failure to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) organizational users and processes acting on behalf of organizational users exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.
checks.remediation: No action needed. Conditional Access policies provide equivalent coverage to Security Defaults.

checks.name: Ensure no user mailboxes are hidden from the Global Address List
checks.impactRationale: Failure to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted system hardening standards exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability.
checks.remediation: Investigate hidden user mailboxes. Mailboxes hidden from the Global Address List may indicate a compromised account. Review: Get-Mailbox -Filter "HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled -eq $true -and RecipientTypeDetails -eq UserMailbox"

checks.name: Site sharing level within tenant policy
checks.impactRationale: Failure to facilitate the implementation of data protection controls exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Ensure SharePointTenantSettings.Read.All permission is consented. Review site sharing levels in SharePoint admin center > Active sites.

checks.name: Sensitive sites have restricted external sharing
checks.impactRationale: Failure to implement this control may expose the tenant to security risks.
checks.remediation: Review site sharing manually in SharePoint admin center > Active sites.

checks.name: Site collection administrator visibility
checks.impactRationale: Failure to proactively govern account management of individual, group, system, service, application, guest and temporary accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: Get-SPOSite | ForEach-Object { Get-SPOSiteAdministrator -Site $_.Url } to enumerate site administrators.

checks.name: Conditional Access policy coverage for SharePoint
checks.impactRationale:
Failure to use automated mechanisms to enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for:
 (1) Remote network access; 
 (2) Third-party Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS); and/ or
 (3) Non-console access to critical TAAS that store, transmit and/or process.
checks.remediation: Ensure Policy.Read.All permission is consented. Create a CA policy targeting SharePoint Online (00000003-0000-0ff1-ce00-000000000000) or All Cloud Apps.

checks.name: Unmanaged device sync restriction
checks.impactRationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.
checks.remediation: Run: Set-SPOTenantSyncClientRestriction -Enable. Also consider Conditional Access policies with device compliance conditions for defense in depth. SharePoint admin center > Settings > Sync.

checks.name: Version history configuration
checks.impactRationale: Failure to conduct a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and "lessons learned" activity every time the contingency plan is activated exposes the tenant to: Emergent properties and/or unintended consequences, Business interruption, Unmitigated vulnerabilities.
checks.remediation: Set version history limits at the library level in SharePoint admin center. Ensure at least 100 major versions are retained for ransomware recovery.

checks.name: Ensure separation of duties for critical admin roles
checks.impactRationale: Failure to implement separation of duties for privileged roles allows a single compromised account to perform all administrative functions without oversight, increasing risk of unauthorized changes, data exfiltration, and privilege abuse.
checks.remediation: Ensure Global Administrator and Privileged Role Administrator roles are assigned to separate accounts. Entra admin center > Identity > Roles & admins. Enable PIM approval workflows for role activation.

checks.name: Ensure Terms of Use agreement policy is configured
checks.impactRationale: Failure to present privacy and security notices before granting system access exposes the organization to legal and compliance risk, as users may not be informed of acceptable use policies, monitoring practices, or data handling requirements.
checks.remediation: Entra admin center > Identity Governance > Terms of use. Verify agreements have "Require users to expand the terms of use" enabled and are assigned via Conditional Access policies.

checks.name: Ensure privileged commands require PIM activation for remote access
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict privileged command execution via remote access enables persistent standing admin access, increasing the attack surface for credential theft, lateral movement, and unauthorized administrative actions.
checks.remediation: Enable Entra ID PIM. Convert permanent role assignments to eligible. Configure activation to require justification and MFA. Entra admin center > Identity Governance > Privileged Identity Management > Entra ID roles.

checks.name: Ensure mobile device compliance policies require encryption
checks.impactRationale: Failure to require encryption on mobile devices exposes CUI and sensitive data to unauthorized disclosure if a device is lost, stolen, or physically compromised.
checks.remediation: Intune admin center > Devices > Compliance > Create/edit iOS and Android compliance policies > Require device encryption.

checks.name: Ensure portable storage devices are restricted on external systems
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict portable storage on external systems enables unauthorized data transfer via USB and removable media, increasing risk of data exfiltration and malware introduction.
checks.remediation: Intune admin center > Devices > Configuration > Create profile > Windows 10 and later > Device restrictions > General > Removable storage: Block.

checks.name: Ensure application control policies restrict unauthorized software
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict unauthorized software execution allows users to install and run unapproved applications, increasing the attack surface for malware, supply chain compromise, and policy violations.
checks.remediation: Intune admin center > Devices > Configuration > Create profile > Endpoint protection > Windows Defender Application Control. Alternatively, deploy WDAC via custom OMA-URI.

checks.name: Ensure vulnerability scanning is active via Defender for Endpoint
checks.impactRationale: Failure to perform routine vulnerability scanning leaves known vulnerabilities undetected, allowing attackers to exploit outdated software and misconfigurations across managed endpoints.
checks.remediation: Enable Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Navigate to security.microsoft.com > Vulnerability management to review coverage. Ensure devices are onboarded to MDE.

checks.name: Ensure FIPS-validated cryptography is enforced on managed devices
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enforce FIPS-validated cryptographic algorithms allows the use of weak or non-compliant encryption, potentially exposing CUI and sensitive data to cryptographic attacks.
checks.remediation: Intune admin center > Devices > Configuration > Create profile > Custom OMA-URI > Add setting: ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Cryptography/AllowFipsAlgorithmPolicy = 1.

checks.name: Ensure Defender Antivirus real-time protection is enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enable real-time anti-malware scanning allows threats to execute unchecked, enabling ransomware, trojans, and other malware to persist and spread across the environment.
checks.remediation: Intune admin center > Endpoint security > Antivirus > Create policy > Microsoft Defender Antivirus > Enable real-time protection.

checks.name: Ensure continuous security monitoring via Microsoft Secure Score
checks.impactRationale: Failure to continuously monitor security controls allows configuration drift and emerging vulnerabilities to go undetected, degrading the overall security posture over time.
checks.remediation: Access Microsoft Secure Score at security.microsoft.com/securescore. Review and act on improvement recommendations regularly.

checks.name: Ensure Intune serves as authoritative device inventory with categories
checks.impactRationale: Failure to maintain an authoritative, categorized component inventory prevents accurate asset tracking and risk assessment, making it impossible to identify unauthorized devices or enforce policy consistently.
checks.remediation: Ensure devices are enrolled in Intune. Configure device categories: Intune admin center > Devices > Device categories > Create category.

checks.name: Ensure automated detection of misconfigured or unauthorized components
checks.impactRationale: Failure to automatically detect misconfigured or unauthorized components allows configuration drift and rogue devices to persist undetected, creating exploitable gaps in the security perimeter.
checks.remediation: Enable Defender for Endpoint device discovery. security.microsoft.com > Settings > Device discovery. Ensure devices are onboarded and configuration assessment is active.

checks.name: Ensure automated device discovery and enrollment is configured
checks.impactRationale: Failure to configure automated device discovery and enrollment allows devices to connect to organizational resources without management oversight, creating blind spots in the inventory and compliance posture.
checks.remediation: Configure Intune automatic enrollment: Entra admin center > Mobility (MDM and WIP) > Microsoft Intune > MDM user scope: All or Some. Consider configuring Windows Autopilot for zero-touch provisioning.

checks.name: Ensure Communication Compliance Policies are Enabled
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enable communication compliance policies leaves organizational communications unmonitored for policy violations, harassment, and data leakage, increasing legal, regulatory, and insider-threat risk.
checks.remediation: Microsoft Purview > Communication compliance > Create a policy to monitor communications for policy violations and insider risk. Requires E5 Compliance licensing.

checks.name: Ensure DLP Policies Cover Exchange and SharePoint/OneDrive
checks.impactRationale: Failure to extend DLP coverage to Exchange and SharePoint/OneDrive leaves the primary workloads for CUI storage and transmission unprotected against accidental or malicious data exfiltration.
checks.remediation: Microsoft Purview > Data loss prevention > Policies > Edit existing policies to include Exchange email and SharePoint/OneDrive locations for comprehensive data protection.

checks.name: Ensure Auto-Sensitivity Labeling Policies are Configured
checks.impactRationale: Failure to configure auto-sensitivity labeling relies solely on user discretion to classify CUI, leading to inconsistent labeling that undermines DLP enforcement and data governance controls.
checks.remediation: Microsoft Purview > Information protection > Auto-labeling > Create a policy to automatically classify sensitive content. Requires Azure Information Protection P2 (E5 or E5 Compliance).

checks.name: Ensure Removable Media Use is Blocked on Managed Devices
checks.impactRationale: Failure to block removable media on managed endpoints enables data exfiltration of CUI via USB drives and SD cards, and introduces malware vectors that bypass network-based controls.

checks.name: Ensure Admin Accounts are Separated from Daily-Use Accounts
checks.impactRationale: Failure to separate privileged admin accounts from daily-use accounts violates user/system management separation, increasing the blast radius of account compromise and enabling privilege escalation through shared identity.

checks.name: Ensure Conditional Access Enforces Session Sign-In Frequency
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enforce session sign-in frequency via Conditional Access allows cloud application sessions to persist indefinitely, leaving inactive connections open and exposing CUI to unauthorized access if a session is hijacked.

checks.name: Ensure PowerShell Execution Policy Restricts Script Execution on Managed Devices
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict PowerShell execution on managed endpoints allows arbitrary script execution, enabling malware deployment, credential theft, and lateral movement that bypasses traditional AV-based controls.

checks.name: Ensure Legacy Authentication Protocols are Blocked to Protect Session Authenticity
checks.impactRationale: Failure to block legacy authentication protocols allows sessions to be established without modern authentication mechanisms, undermining communications session authenticity and enabling credential-spraying and man-in-the-middle attacks.

checks.name: Ensure SharePoint External Sharing Restricts Access to CUI on Digital Media
checks.impactRationale: Failure to restrict SharePoint external sharing allows CUI stored in cloud digital media to be accessed by unauthorized external parties, violating media access controls and data governance requirements.

checks.name: Ensure Microsoft 365 Backup is Enabled to Protect Backup CUI Confidentiality
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enable Microsoft 365 Backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange leaves backup CUI without verified confidentiality protection, increasing risk of data loss or unauthorized disclosure from backup storage.

checks.name: Ensure VPN Split Tunneling is Prevented on Managed Devices
checks.impactRationale: Allowing split tunneling on VPN-connected devices permits simultaneous access to organizational systems and untrusted networks, creating a data exfiltration pathway and bypassing organizational security controls.

checks.name: Ensure WiFi Enterprise Authentication and Encryption on Managed Devices
checks.impactRationale: Failure to enforce enterprise-grade WiFi authentication (WPA2-Enterprise/EAP-TLS) allows unauthorized devices to connect to corporate wireless networks and exposes CUI transmitted over unencrypted or weakly-encrypted channels.

checks.name: Ensure Remote Access Enforces Device Compliance via Conditional Access
checks.impactRationale: Without device compliance requirements scoped to remote (non-corporate-network) access, unmanaged or compromised endpoints can authenticate to organizational systems from external networks, violating least privilege for remote access.

checks.name: Ensure Always-On VPN Is Configured for Managed Remote Devices
checks.impactRationale: Without an Always-On VPN profile routing all remote device traffic through a managed access control point, remote endpoints may connect directly to the internet, bypassing organizational security controls and logging.
